source.meaning: The labelled development cases and stress controls support bounded development observations. The full-reference run supplies unlabelled execution coverage, not measured correctness of its criteria.

profiles.exclusions: All other criteria are outside this profile: all choice operations, evidence_select, misreading checks, general answerability, answer_in_seen, feedback truth or guidance, hints, prompt clarity, and serves_the_lesson. The response-to-rubric evidence does not qualify evidence-selection labels, and the small authored choice controls do not establish the reference choice route. Exclusion is unavailable coverage, not a passed or inapplicable check.
limitations: Criterion-family selection is a development decision, not validation of every selected criterion, operation, or future item.
Reported model identity and sample agreement do not establish an immutable serving revision or correctness.
Learner exposure, academic approval and learner outcomes remain unverified.
